day.reading: 10% selective mortality is a total budget, about 1 beneficial substitution per 300 generations for mammals
day.holds: 30/0.10 = 300 exactly; N cancels; the figure matches Nunney's report of Haldane

critic.reading: the arithmetic is accepted; it bounds selected substitutions only, under hard selection, not drift
critic.holds: the budget is stated in deaths per beneficial substitution, so neutral fixations pay none (PS-04); hard/soft is M-803

notes: 300 = 30/0.10 holds exactly and is independent of N, so Nesslig20's N_e notation changes nothing. The 300 is verified only as Nunney 2003 reports Haldane; Haldane 1957 is not retrieved, so the D = 30 and 10% inputs are Haldane's as relayed. D = 30 is above the new-copy value 2 ln(2N) = 19.8 at N = 1e4 (about 200 generations at 10%), so 300 is the slower end of Haldane's own accounting. Whether the budget binds (hard vs soft selection, M = 2Ku) is M-803, not this record.
